LESSON: DIVISION

Grade: Grade 2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Numbers
Topic 1.7: Division

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Division. Read, look at the pictures, practise, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: LOOK AND LEARN

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-117.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 117]]

Work to do Share equally to 3 pupils This is 6 ÷ 3

Put into 2 equal groups This is 8 ____ 2 105

From your pupil's book (page 115)

NUMBERS DIVISION Week 7 Lesson 2 Equal sharing Activity Share equally 6 bottle tops between 2 pupils. Pick one at a time

Each pupil gets 3 bottle tops Work to do How many each? Share 8 oranges equally between 2 pupils.

Each pupil gets oranges Share 6 seeds equally between 2 pupils.

Each pupil gets seeds Share 8 balls equally among 4 pupils

Each pupil gets balls Share 15 pebbles equally between 5 pupils

[[image:/media/pupil-books/grade-2/mathematics/page-170.jpg|Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2 — page 170]]

From your pupil's book (page 170)

TERM 3 NUMBERS DIVISION Week 5 Lesson 4 Divide Activity 1 Divide 8 ÷ 4=

SECTION 3: TRY THIS

1. Look again at the examples or pictures above.
2. Tell a parent or friend what Division means, using your own words.
3. Copy one example into your exercise book and change it to fit your school or home.
4. Underline three new words and find out what they mean.

SECTION 4: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Division.
2. Complete any “Work to do” items shown in the pupil book pages above.
3. Create three of your own practice questions on this topic.
4. Answer the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after finishing.

SECTION 5: REMEMBER

1. Topic: Division
2. Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
3. Learning materials: Mathematics Pupil Book Grade 2
4. Revise with the quiz now.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
